_comment: Copy to config.json (gitignored; install.sh and the SD card kit create it). kart_id is a display label only: the Heltec's own id (from its self lines) wins and a mismatch is flagged. pit_urls are tried in order for the map package. beginner_mode hides driver-facing fault alerts only. map_orientation: heading_up (default; map turns with the kart at <= 120 deg/s, kart ~60 % down the map, held below 1.5 m/s) or north_up; applies only while following the own kart. follow_span_m: metres shown across the map height while following (70). remote_cmd lets other machines POST /cmd (debug only). game: false makes this kart ignore the pit's game zones (no boost/mud commands, no laps). sound: game sounds on the driver page. gps_correction (default false): shift game positions by (pit surveyed position - pit radio live fix), 30 s mean, only if under 25 m. demo: allow demo mode (hold the KART badge 3 s; a simulated kart drives the zones, the real Heltec is never written to). demo_max_s: demo ends by itself after this.
